dataset.seed_definition: fixed catalog, recipe and stock values; one Owner and one assigned Manager; generated auth credentials remain runtime-only

measurement.cache_hit_ratio: request-local validated cache lookup, cleared if source list reloads; denominator catalog GETs only
measurement.latency: client-side HTTP request duration, including auth middleware, authorization and response serialization
measurement.postgres_queries: SQLAlchemy before_cursor_execute events scoped by request-local context and returned in X-Benchmark-Postgres-Queries; setup/migration/seed/login are excluded
measurement.sql_phase_costs: nonoverlapping before/after cursor execution counts and durations; includes database wait/driver time, excludes DTO/Python/HTTP time; not additive latency percentiles

runtime.api_execution: separate API subprocess and HTTP load-generator process; no shared Python interpreter/GIL
runtime.auth_refresh_strategy: POST /auth/refresh between batches at 80% of access lifetime
runtime.configuration_source: explicit Settings defaults and benchmark overrides; dotenv and ambient settings ignored
runtime.database_pool: SQLAlchemy default pool for the long-lived API process
runtime.redis: Redis server v=7.4.11 sha=00000000:0 malloc=jemalloc-5.3.0 bits=64 build=40ff01a501d8e4b6
runtime.windows_socket_poll_guard: WinError 10038 during idle pool check means expired; no request replay

workloads.mixed-write: 20% catalog PUT updates (10% item, 10% menu) + 80% menu-item GETs
